method: Independent web open/find of standards, original paper and official product docs; not copied from the author checklist

verified: Authorization has explicit shared-cache exceptions for must-revalidate/public/s-maxage; chapter deliberately uses a stricter pass policy before lookup
Vary selects matching representation inputs and does not authorize
A reused response propagates current Age rather than renewing at Shield
fresh shared responses can evaluate applicable client If-None-Match without contacting origin
private/no-store/no-cache have different unqualified semantics; strict baseline cannot casually serve stale
If-None-Match on GET uses weak entity-tag comparison, accepts lists or star
validators must match the selected representation/coding semantics
302 is not generally heuristically cacheable;404 can be; explicit cache directives govern the chapter's negative profile
SWR and stale-if-error are independent extensions, both intervals measured after staleness; the chapter's10/5/15 arithmetic is a teaching profile
look-aside client owns DB fetch after miss
lease token is key-bound, delete can invalidate it, and rate-controlled leases reduce same-key amplification
sources.scope: chapter floor/epoch/SQLite transaction/1s/20s/5s budgets are its own design, not the paper's measurements

verified: one Group suppresses in-flight duplicate calls for a key
this does not imply cross-process origin admission, fencing or physical query cancellation
immutable means unchanged during freshness, not permanent retention or instant revocation
edge invalidation leaves local/browser/corporate caches until their expiry; versioned names control different bytes
invalidation request has a queryable identity and status; accepted request is distinct from completion; no time bound transferred into this chapter
one write transaction per file across connections, BEGIN IMMEDIATE obtains writer before reads; tests exercise local file serialization only
